exportCode.jsonSchema.enumOpen: Open enumeration. The known values are in x-known-values. Unknown values are valid too
exportCode.typescript.enumOpen: Open enumeration: unknown values are valid too. Do not assume the list is exhaustive
exportCode.zod.enumOpen: Open enumeration: unknown values are accepted too. The known values are {cname}Known
exportCode.zod.headerGetters:
Circular and mutual references use Zod 4's getter syntax.
Type inference works as it is, so no extra type annotations are needed.
exportCode.zod.headerRecorded:
"Rule not generated" marks a rule that refers to another document or contains an
expression, so this generator cannot turn it into validation code. It is kept only
as a comment. For a machine-readable definition, see x-rules in the JSON Schema output.
exportCode.zod.headerStrict:
Objects are z.strictObject. Unknown fields are rejected, not stripped
(this matches additionalProperties: false in the JSON Schema output).
